methodology.aggregation: Median across three independent Node/Vitest processes; raw runs remain in baseline.json and optimized.json.
methodology.fixtures: Synthetic decklists, projects, JPEGs and PNGs only; offline; no copyrighted images and no real internet requests.
methodology.memory: RSS/heap sampled at 5 ms while an asynchronous scenario runs; event-loop delay is sampled, not an absolute CI gate.
methodology.uiLimitation: Only React server rendering was measured. Chromium and Playwright are unavailable in this environment; browser scroll, focus, keyboard, drag/drop, paint and interaction timings are unmeasured.
methodology.importLimitation: Import scenarios exercise the local Universal Import parser/preview/Working Set path and do not include file selection, filesystem persistence or remote catalog access.
